people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Arnon
people.line: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
translations.bsb: “Arise, set out, and cross the Arnon Valley. See, I have delivered into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land. Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle.
translations.kjv: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
translations.asv: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon: behold, I have given into thy hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
